title: Repeated distributions for killed gauges can block valid distributions
summary: _Resolved_  ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  **Note: Distributions for killed (standard) gauges will currently fail, so this report assumes that the killed gauge referred to is an AlgebraGauge**.  When a gauge is killed, the pending emissions for that gauge, for the current period, are re-routed back to the `minter` contract. Additionally, the `es.distributed` flag is *not* set to `true`.
